description: This file contains unit tests for the CheckExternalFilter class, verifying its behavior in reading from and writing to external headers, immutability, case sensitivity, and interactions with headers definitions.

classes.name: CheckExternalFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of CheckExternalFilter functionalities such as immutability, header filtering logic, case insensitivity, and null argument handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that CheckExternalFilter class is immutable and its fields are safely copied and unmodifiable.

methods.name: tryToGetShouldReadFromExternalNullHeaderDefinitions
methods.description: Verifies that passing null headerDefinitions to shouldReadFromExternal throws NullPointerException with appropriate message.

methods.name: filterNullValueShouldReadFromExternal
methods.description: Checks that filtering null value returns null and does not interact with headerDefinitions.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinitionShouldBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Ensures that a value with a key not in headerDefinitions is returned as-is.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Verifies that a value for a header present in headerDefinitions is returned.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldNotBeReadFromExternal
methods.description: Checks that a header key not meant for external read returns null.

methods.name: tryToGetShouldWriteToExternalNullHeaderDefinitions
methods.description: Verifies that passing null headerDefinitions to shouldWriteToExternal throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: filterNullValueShouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Checks that filtering null value in write mode returns null without interactions.

methods.name: filterValueWithoutMatchingHeaderDefinitionShouldWriteToExternal
methods.description: Ensures that value for a key not in headerDefinitions is returned as-is.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldBeExposedExternally
methods.description: Verifies that headers meant to be exposed externally are returned when filtered.

methods.name: filterValueThatShouldNotBeExposedExternally
methods.description: Checks that headers not meant for external exposure return null.

methods.name: filterShouldNotBeCaseSensitiveForDefinitionKey
methods.description: Ensures that key matching is case insensitive for header definition keys.

methods.name: doFilterShouldNotBeCaseSensitiveForDefinitionKey
methods.description: Helper method testing case insensitivity for different key cases.
